name: Classic Cold Brew
description: Smooth, rich, and refreshingly simple. Our slow-steeped signature cold brew brings deep coffee flavor without the fuss.
body: Our Classic Cold Brew is where Caldoro began. We steep a medium-roast blend from Colombia and Brazil in cold, filtered water for more than 12 hours, then filter it twice for a clean, round cup.
Enjoy it black over ice, or add a splash of milk. It is bold enough to wake you up and smooth enough to sip slowly.
notes: Cocoa, toasted nuts, a clean finish

name: Vanilla Cloud Latte
description: A mellow cold brew blended with creamy milk and a soft touch of vanilla. Comfort in every chilled sip.
body: We pair our cold brew concentrate with whole milk and a house-made vanilla bean syrup. The result is soft, creamy, and lightly sweet.
Ask for oat milk if you prefer it dairy-free. The vanilla still shines through.

name: Golden Oat Latte
description: A balanced espresso-style coffee blend with oat milk for a naturally smooth, plant-based favorite.
body: Golden Oat is our fully plant-based favorite. Creamy oat milk meets a brighter coffee blend and a hint of brown sugar.
It is naturally smooth, never heavy, and made for slow mornings.
notes: Toasted oats, brown sugar, gentle coffee

name: Mocha Daydream
description: Deep coffee meets chocolatey goodness in a chilled drink made for your little afternoon reset.
body: Mocha Daydream blends our cold brew with real Dutch cocoa and a little cane sugar, then finishes it with cold milk.
It tastes like a chocolate bar and a good coffee had a very good afternoon together.

name: Salted Honey Brew
description: Cold brew sweetened with wildflower honey and a pinch of sea salt, topped with a light layer of cream.
body: We sweeten this one with local wildflower honey and add a pinch of flaky sea salt to round out the coffee.
A light cold foam on top makes every sip a little richer.
notes: Wildflower honey, sea salt, soft cream

name: Sunrise Tonic
description: Sparkling tonic poured over cold brew with a twist of fresh orange. Bright, bubbly, and made for warm days.
body: Sunrise Tonic layers our Classic Cold Brew over chilled tonic water and finishes it with a fresh orange twist.
It is light, sparkling, and a little unexpected. Our favorite pick for summer afternoons.
